goals_native: să explici de ce vrei postul
scene.topic_description:
Situation: The interview moves to the decisive part, where the recruiter tests motivation and past experience. This is the core interaction because the learner's main worry is handling questions about experience well enough to show fit for the role and leave a strong impression.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Recruiter.
Not in this scene: introductions, stating your name, saying which job you applied for, basic work history, salary negotiation, signing documents.
must_say: answer why you want this job — slot: the reason
explain which experience fits the role — slot: the relevant experience
give a concrete example of a success — slot: the achievement
answer how you handled a problem at work — slot: the problem
ask whether a skill is important for the role — slot: the skill
ask what the team is like — slot: the aspect of the team
ask when they will make a decision — slot: none
must_understand: asks why you want this job
asks which past experience is most relevant
asks for an example of a success or a difficult situation
asks how you work with others or under pressure
says when they will contact candidates

findings.detail: «nouvelle» is a word of the stop list («nouvelle»)
the definition «to have a role or effect» of «jouer» reads as en, not fr (have)
the definition «to tell about an event» of «raconter» reads as en, not fr (about)
the definition «information received from someone» of «nouvelle» reads as en, not fr (from)

TARGET_LANGUAGE: French

NATIVE_LANGUAGE: Romanian

LEVEL: Intermediate

LEARNER_GENDER: unknown

LEARNER_ROLE: Candidat / Candidat

topic.description_target: Answer motivation and experience questions, give examples, and ask about the team and the decision timeline.
topic.description_native: Răspundeți la întrebări despre motivație și experiență, dați exemple și întrebați despre echipă și termenul deciziei.

phrases.frame_target: Ce que j'ai appris me sert pour ___
phrases.frame_native: Ceea ce am învățat mă ajută ___
phrases.pronunciation_native: să că je apri mă ser pur ___

phrases.frame_target: Est-ce que ___ compte pour ce poste ?
phrases.pronunciation_native: es că ___ kont pur să post

partner_lines.text_native: De ce vă doriți acest post?

partner_lines.text_target: Quelle expérience passée vous prépare le mieux pour ce poste ?
partner_lines.text_native: Ce experiență anterioară vă pregătește cel mai bine pentru acest post?

partner_lines.text_target: Pouvez-vous donner un exemple d'une réussite concrète ?
partner_lines.text_native: Puteți da un exemplu de reușită concretă?
Puteți povesti despre o situație dificilă?

partner_lines.text_target: Comment vous entendez-vous avec les autres ?
Que faites-vous quand la pression augmente ?
Vous aurez de nos nouvelles la semaine prochaine, après les derniers entretiens.
partner_lines.text_native: Veți primi vești de la noi săptămâna viitoare, după ultimele interviuri.

vocabulary.definition_target: to gain knowledge or a skill
vocabulary.image_prompt: A person studying notes at a desk during professional training

vocabulary.definition_target: to resolve a problem or disagreement
vocabulary.image_prompt: A worker resolving a scheduling problem at a computer

vocabulary.definition_target: to have a role or effect
a formal meeting to assess a candidate
vocabulary.image_prompt: A recruiter interviewing a candidate across a desk
